profile.name: 双束聚焦离子束扫描电子显微镜
profile.description: 这是一类将扫描电子显微镜与聚焦离子束集成在同一平台上的双束显微镜，可用于样品表面成像、离子束刻蚀与铣削、气体辅助沉积、样品台精密定位以及自动对准。它常用于截面制备、薄片制备、沟槽铣削、序列切片成像和体成像等实验流程。
profile.description_en: This is a dual-beam microscope that combines a scanning electron microscope with a focused ion beam on one platform. It is used for surface imaging, ion-beam milling and patterning, gas-assisted deposition, precise stage positioning, and automated alignment. Typical lab uses include cross-section preparation, lamella preparation, trench milling, serial sectioning, and volume imaging workflows.
